items.q: Match each parameter with its normal urine value — 1) pH 2) Specific gravity 3) Osmolality (mOsm/kg) … A) 1.020-1.040 B) 800-900 C) 4-4.5 (acidic)
items.exp: Urine pH 4-4.5 (acidic); specific gravity 1.020-1.040; osmolality 800-900 mOsm/kg. (Book p741)

items.q: The normal blood osmolality quoted beside the urine column is:
items.exp: Blood osmolality 285-290 mOsm/kg against urine 800-900 mOsm/kg. (Book p741)

items.q: In the acidification diagram, the cell and luminal pump responsible are:
opts: Alpha-intercalated cells of the cortical collecting duct with H+ ATPase
Principal cells of the cortical collecting duct with Na-K ATPase
Beta-intercalated cells of the proximal tubule with H+ ATPase
Podocytes of the glomerulus with aquaporin-2
items.exp: Alpha-intercalated cells of cortical collecting duct (CCD) secrete H+ via the luminal H+ ATPase. (Book p741)

items.q: Fill up: Secreted H+ buffered by NH3 forms the non-titratable, major acid ______.
items.exp: NH3 + H+ → NH4+ : non titratable, major acid. (Book p741)

items.q: Fill up: Buffering of secreted H+ by HPO4 2- yields the titratable acid ______.
items.exp: HPO4 2- + H+ → H2PO4- : titratable acid. (Book p741)

items.q: Urinary concentration rests on ADH from the posterior pituitary, the vasa recta and a medullary interstitium whose osmolality is raised by:
items.exp: Medullary interstitium: ↑ osmolality d/t urea; ADH → free water reabsorption; vasa recta. (Book p741)

items.q: A patient's urine pH stays above 5.5 for 3 days while the RFT remains normal. The label for this picture is:
items.exp: Urine pH > 5.5 for 3 days + normal RFT → Type-1 renal tubular acidosis (RTA). (Book p741)

items.q: Diabetes insipidus (dilute urine) is flagged when specific gravity and osmolality fall below:
items.exp: Urine specific gravity < 1.005 and urine osmolality < 300 mOsm/kg → diabetes insipidus (↑ dilute urine). (Book p741)

items.q: Isosthenuria, defined as urinary parameters equal to blood parameters, points to:
opts: Acute tubular necrosis and chronic tubulo-interstitial disease
Prerenal azotemia and bladder outlet obstruction
items.exp: Isosthenuria (urinary parameters = blood parameters): ATN; chronic tubulo-interstitial disease (CTID). (Book p741)
